workItems.title: Project canonical components and logical implementation ownership
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Preserve canonical stable component identities/provenance and repository-profile support; explicit logical path ownership within shared projects and multi-component test verification resolve deterministically with visible conflicts and omissions. Reconcile accepted current consumer modules through RM-08 without inventing new requirements.
workItems.validation: Focused graph component/identity/evidence regressions exercise canonical tables, legacy declarations, overlapping logical roots, conflicting primary owners and one test verifying multiple components. Inspect accepted consumer module boundaries and exact paths.

workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Current impact and verification selection coalesce necessary refresh through existing orchestration, detect dirty add/edit/delete/dependency/interpretation changes, preserve historical navigation and approved baselines, expose scoped diagnostics and choose configured full fallback when dependency knowledge is uncertain. Retain existing report/authority/environment/settlement compatibility checks.

The complete advisory envelope including metadata is size-bounded and remains separate from canonical authority. Opt-in concise mutation/status output preserves default machine compatibility and detail access.

workItems.title: Reuse measured completion review under current material authority
workItems.acceptanceCriteria: Measure completion phases before selecting optimization; reusable pure review is keyed by current task/criteria/authority/material/policy/graph/receipt/report interpretation while final current input/contract concurrency fence remains uncached. Explain review reuse separately from native result reuse and actual execution; same-state calls cannot hide stale evidence.
